prompt: The final duel of the Horus Heresy. Aboard the Vengeful Spirit in orbit above a burning Terra, the Emperor of Mankind faces his favored son, Warmaster Horus, now fully consumed by Chaos.
promptEn: The final duel of the Horus Heresy. Aboard the Vengeful Spirit in orbit above a burning Terra, the Emperor of Mankind faces his favored son, Warmaster Horus, now fully consumed by Chaos.
promptZh: 荷鲁斯之乱的最终决斗。在燃烧中的泰拉轨道上，人类帝皇于复仇之魂号内直面他曾经最宠爱的儿子——已被混沌彻底吞噬的战争领主荷鲁斯。
